name: x402 Payment with Fresh Agent Testnet Wallet
query: Create a fresh Radius testnet wallet, fund it from the faucet, then call this x402 endpoint and pay for the response. Do it as an automated agent demo.
context: The user wants a one-shot automated demo using a new testnet wallet. The agent must avoid interactive Foundry keystore prompts and raw private keys in CLI arguments. The x402 endpoint supports Radius testnet, PAYMENT-REQUIRED, EIP-2612 gas sponsoring, and Permit2.
expected_behavior: Bootstraps a fresh testnet wallet with radius-wallet-bootstrap.mjs
Loads .radius/wallets/<name>.env and uses OWNER as the faucet address
Funds the wallet with the dripping-faucet viem/app-code path and verifies SBC balance on Radius testnet
Consumes the x402 endpoint with the viem client path from x402-client.md, not the cast CLI path
Reads PAYMENT-REQUIRED, selects accepts[0], reads the EIP-2612 nonce, signs EIP-2612 and Permit2 typed data with the env-backed viem account, sends PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, and reports the response
Does not use CAST_ACCOUNT, cast wallet sign, or Foundry keystore prompts for the fresh helper-created wallet
success_criteria: Uses Radius testnet chain ID 72344 and RPC https://rpc.testnet.radiustech.xyz
SBC balance is checked on-chain after faucet funding
Amount handling uses 6-decimal SBC raw units
EIP-2612 domain uses name Stable Coin and version 1
Permit2 spender is the x402 Proxy 0x402085c248EeA27D92E8b30b2C58ed07f9E20001
EIP-2612 spender is the Permit2 contract 0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3
No raw private key is printed, logged, hardcoded, or passed as a CLI argument
The final paid request returns or reports the service response
